title: A session answer that arrives after a later login overwrote the gateway's CSRF token, so the next logout sent a stale token
resolution: The gateway's token keeper counts ended logins and logouts and drops the token of an answer sent before one ended; interleaving tests with held answers fail before the fix.

title: After a successful logout the authenticated shell and its expiry check stayed until the follow-up session read answered, and that read could overwrite a newer login
resolution: The provider shows the sign-in page as soon as the logout ends, which cancels the expiry check, and applies any answer only if no newer view showed; tests of a delayed read and of logout, expiry, and login interleavings fail before the fix.

title: An empty, HTML, or incomplete session body raised an unhandled TypeError and left the sign-in form submitting
resolution: The gateway checks the body fields it uses and maps any other body to unavailable; the provider reads a rejected gateway call as unavailable or a failed logout, and the form always leaves its submitting state; tests of empty, HTML, and incomplete bodies fail before the fix.

title: The contrast test skipped hover pairs, and the hovered light primary in the light scheme measured 4.13:1
resolution: The test checks every variant at rest and hovered and the hovered navigation link; indigo.2 #c8d3ff in createTheme lifts the pair to 4.59:1; the new hovered pair failed at 4.127 before the theme fix.

title: At 320 px the header's five controls, logo, gaps, and padding need more than the width, so 44 px targets overflow or shrink
resolution: Below sm the header keeps the burger, the logo, Needs you, and the account menu, and the navbar takes New task and the scheme switch through Mantine visibleFrom and hiddenFrom (244 px needed); the phone-width test fails before the fix.

title: The session shell requirement showed only a retry for any unreachable control plane, against its own login and logout scenarios
resolution: The requirement limits the retry page to a session read without a valid answer and keeps the current page for a failed login or logout; new scenarios cover invalid answers and late answers.

title: The bundle boundary requirement dropped "of an external origin" and so forbade the SPA's own URLs
resolution: The requirement again names a URL of an external origin, keeping the fixed list of library texts.

title: The review plan cited governance v10 and Argon while the reviewed tree held v9, and called medium the routed effort although route.json recommends high
resolution: After the merge of origin/dev 26697ab0 (#419) the branch holds v10; the plan cites the owner decision of 2026-11-02 and calls medium the authorized effort.

title: The invalid-request hint and the sign-in fields omitted LoginName's leading letter or digit, its 64-character maximum, and Password's 1024
resolution: The hint states the LoginName pattern and both maxima, and the fields carry maxLength 64 and 1024; the boundary and hint tests fail before the fix.
